subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt a nested preview/tool-progress policy, and should the gateway config mutation boundary remain protected for `channels.feishu.streaming`?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the safe fix changes Feishu public config semantics and potentially the model-to-operator config mutation boundary.

options.title: Adopt Feishu preview policy
options.body: Add a backward-compatible Feishu preview policy for tool progress and command text while preserving current boolean defaults and documenting the migration behavior.

options.title: Only adjust exec wording
options.body: Reduce scary exec-failure wording without adding a Feishu opt-out, which helps the label but leaves users unable to keep streaming while hiding progress noise.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Permit `channels.feishu.streaming` through `config.patch`, which helps recovery but broadens an agent-tunable channel config path and still lacks status-only progress control.

recommendation.title: Adopt Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Add a backward-compatible Feishu preview policy for tool progress and command text while preserving current boolean defaults and documenting the migration behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata identifies this handle as the community-maintained plugin contact for Feishu-owned policy decisions.
